question: Pandit Birju Maharaj received which of the following awards in 1986?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Birju Maharaj attained prominence in the Kathak dance form.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is also known as Brijmohan Mishra.
 
• He belongs to Lucknow **Gharana **of Kathak.
 
• He was honoured with Padma Vibhushan Award in the year 1986.
